describe:

starEffectDesc: Other Ultimate formes will reverse the world for 3 rounds: -15% Rage Regen Speed for all enemies; Origin Forme continues for 1 more round

starEffectDesc_en: Other Ultimate formes will reverse the world for 3 rounds: -15% Rage Regen Speed for all enemies; Origin Forme continues for 1 more round

describe: When Giratina enters the battle, gains a ghost shadow for an ally on the field (Ghost Shadow Cap: 5 Points, cannot be dispelled or ignored).
